Sam H: Quick distilled runbook for go-live warmup + renewal-watch. Keep it copy/paste for AEs.
Ivy N: Short and sweet pls.
Sam H: Runbook steps (one-liner each):
1) Prefill top 20 prompts to populate KV + embeddings.
2) Reserve warm pool = max(2, ceil(est_concurrency*0.5)).
3) Prime model KV and prefix cache.
4) Run two streaming checks: full stream + truncated chunk.
5) Monitor first-72h signals and tag renewal-risk if triggered.
Carlos G: Prefill curl (pasteable):
```bash
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/prefill" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant":"beta_inc","prompts":["welcome","help"],"limit":20}'
```
Ivy N: Streaming smoke (curl SSE):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"test","max_tokens":40}' \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=redwood-mini"
```
Sam H: Retry guidance: exponential backoff + full jitter, max 3 retries, fall back to async queue if >20s cumulative latency.
Sam H: Renewal-risk quick triggers: sustained 5xx >2% baseline, 15% drop in completion rate, repeated 429s in first 72h, poor go-live survey (<=3). Tag `renewal-risk` and schedule 15-min AE check.
Carlos G: Monitoring snippet (pseudo):
`alert: TenantErrorSpike when rate(http_errors{tenant=\"beta_inc\"}[5m]) > 5 for 10m`
ops-bot: prefill/job jf-99 started by @Carlos G  ETA 90s.
alerts-bot: Alert rule created: TenantErrorSpike for beta_inc.
Ivy N: I'll run the streaming smoke for Beta on Wed 09:00 PT.
Sam H: Thanks — I'll publish this as a 1-pager and add the short feedback form link. TL;DR: prefill -> reserve warm pool -> smoke stream -> monitor -> tag & engage.
